يلجوا (form I)
# يَلَجُّوا (yalajjū) /ja.lad͡ʒ.d͡ʒuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of لَجَّ (lajja)

# يُلَجُّوا (yulajjū) /ju.lad͡ʒ.d͡ʒuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of لَجَّ (lajja)
